percentileDefinition: Sort ascending; h=(n-1)*p; linearly interpolate floor(h) and ceil(h).

metrics.semantics: Each sample is 0 or 1 for one source-frame deadline derived from source PTS and the fixed output cadence; a universal 16.7 ms assumption is forbidden.

Each sample is recomputed from one paired enabled/disabled QPC window with at least 3000 source frames. The measurement index binds both run IDs, frame counts, and the exact capture interval; an unbound aggregate counter is invalid.
CPU time owned by Yanami around, but excluding, mpv_render_context_render. The render-thread probe is allocation-free and uses only relaxed fixed-size counters.

invariants.semantics: Pass only when the reference fingerprint explicitly declares 8K unsupported, or every declared-supported 8K30/60 asset completes the hard playback matrix with hardware decode active.
Every timed window keeps requested and effective provider/profile/shader hashes equal; any fallback, auto-downgrade, or original-quality interval invalidates that preset scenario.
